areas.label: 1번 · 순서 고정 손패
areas.note: 첫 카드가 앞쪽. 신규 뽑기는 뒤쪽에 차례대로 추가. 거래로 빠진 카드를 제외한 나머지 순서를 바꾸지 않는다.

areas.label: 1번 · 콩 카드 뒷면 수익
areas.note: 별도 금화 실물이 아니라 수확한 콩 카드의 뒷면이다. 같은 카드 ID가 밭과 수익 더미에 동시에 존재하지 않는다.

areas.label: 1번 · 실제 2개 콩밭
areas.note: 각 위치는 밭/같은 콩 카드 더미 하나다. capacity1은 카드 한 장이 아니라 밭 위치 하나이며 작물 스택 길이를 제한하지 않는다.

areas.label: 1번 · 받은 뒤 심기 대기
areas.note: 거래가 성립해 받은 카드는 옆에 가로로 둔다. 손패로 합치거나 다시 거래하지 않는다. 상대 소유/합의 완료를 기록한다.

App integration is separate; assets do not execute negotiations/harvest/scoring.

assetScope: Every3–5player ordered hand/2or3field mat/income/received queue, shared2revealed cards, negotiation, deck/discard/cycle and checkpoints. Whole-table SVG/JSON assets only.

tableModel.edition: AMIGO01661,1997/2016 rule sheet v5.4,current3–5person base. No historical purchased-third-field or expanded2/6/7player rules.

coordinates.hand: ordered front-to-back with draw append direction recorded; presentation may fan but cannot sort
coordinates.fieldPile: individual cards stack/cascade on actual field position, full contents/count retained; viewport expands beyond sample silhouettes
coordinates.receivedCards: landscape beside fields, separate from ordered hand
coordinates.coinPile: coin backs up; same physical bean-card instances, never extra currency copies

componentInventory.supportCardFaces: two start cards and overview faces for five players; fifth overview is reverse of second start card, so not seven physical cards

tableModel.ownershipAndTransfer: An offer does not move a card. Once both parties agree, remove the exact physical card without reordering remaining hand. Received cards are laid sideways beside the recipient fields and must be planted; they cannot be re-traded or inserted into a hand.
tableModel.harvest: One actual field contains one bean type but its card stack has no invented capacity. After harvest, some same physical cards flip coin-side into income and the remainder go to public discard. Preserve split transfer checkpoint; do not leave harvested copies in the field.
tableModel.deckCycle: Reshuffle actual discard when draw deck empties. Record exhaustion count and phase. If third exhaustion occurs during reveal/trade, finish that phase and received-card planting before final harvest; do not blindly skip pending public deals.
tableModel.incomePrivacy: Income is coin-card backs. Do not expose the underlying bean fronts from an income count or known physical id unless permitted by captured visibility. Hidden draw order and hand identities stay scoped.

fieldBindings.coins.scene: same bean cards flipped into coinCardIds
fieldBindings.trade.scene: shared reveal/deals and per-recipient planting queues

tableModel.ruleAutomation: No beanometer payout computation, single-bean protection, mandatory planting/trade legality, card sorting, final scoring or winner adjudication.
